tagline.en_US: A web-based platform for managing and remotely accessing computers and other devices. The slim image uses the built-in NeDB database, so a separate MongoDB service is not required.

description.en_US: MeshCentral is a computer management web platform designed to remotely monitor and control devices on a local network or over the internet. Once agents are installed on target machines, they connect back to the server for administration. The platform provides full web-based remote desktop, remote terminal, and file management capabilities directly in the browser.
